review: The hymn is 2 Corinthians 12:9 set as a dialogue: 1:1–3 is the divine word itself (דַּי־לְךָ חַסְדִּי, the Hebrew of 2 Cor 12:9), 2:1–6 is Ps 107:4–5 with Isa 40:29, 3:1–6 is 2 Cor 12:9–10, and 4:1–6 is Ps 55:23 with Isa 41:10.

The refrain is the same Hebrew sentence in all thirteen places, because the print repeats نِعْمَتِي تَكْفِيك unchanged and the whole piece is built on the iteration. Stanza 1 has three lines (the acclamation, the speaker's introduction, the quoted word) and the rest six.

1:2 keeps the colon before direct speech and does not put quotation marks inside the line, per the glossary convention; the print's «» marks are represented by the colon plus the refrain that follows.
